gloss: usable in both sun and rain; all-weather

definitions.gloss: usable in both sun and rain; all-weather (umbrella, etc.)
definitions.explanation: Describes an item — most often an umbrella or parasol — that can be used both as a sunshade and for rain. Standard product-category label in Japanese shops.

examples.japanese: {晴雨兼用|せいうけんよう}の{傘|かさ}を{買|か}った。
この{日傘|ひがさ}は{晴雨兼用|せいうけんよう}だから{便利|べんり}だ。
examples.english: This parasol is convenient because it works in both sun and rain.

examples.japanese: {急|きゅう}な{雨|あめ}にも{備|そな}えて、{晴雨兼用|せいうけんよう}の{折|お}りたたみ{傘|がさ}を{持|も}ち{歩|ある}いている。
examples.english: I carry a folding all-weather umbrella so I'm ready for sudden rain.

notes:
Compound of {晴|せい} (clear) + {雨|う} (rain) + {兼用|けんよう} (combined use). Almost always used as a noun modifier with の.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {晴雨兼用|せいうけんよう}{傘|がさ}: all-weather umbrella
- {晴雨兼用|せいうけんよう}の{日傘|ひがさ}: all-weather parasol
- {晴雨兼用|せいうけんよう}タイプ: all-weather type/model

USAGE:
Frequently seen on product tags and signage in department stores and online retail. The opposite category labels are {雨傘|あまがさ}{専用|せんよう} (rain only) and {日傘|ひがさ}{専用|せんよう} (sun only).
